intent: Use standard JavaScript object construction, inspection and integrity operations inside confined Code Mode without exposing host objects or relaxing confinement
selection: All files in the directory, with the current project manifest's existing flags/features/harness/boundary rules except removal of the property-descriptors API boundary and admission of verbatim propertyHelper.js. No selection by runtime pass/fail. Keep accessor-descriptor cases not excluded by the existing literal-getter boundary, arrays, functions and unrelated failures. Do not claim complete ECMAScript conformance.
runner: Use the same current production Test262 runner on each actual checkout. Its bytes already match the inspiring feature's runner. Extend only harness-include loading to prepend the unchanged pinned propertyHelper.js when requested. Never replace production functions or implement missing descriptors in the harness.
scoring: Report non-negative tests passed/total, separate negative tests, all selection exclusions, per-Object-operation results, gains and losses. Test262 assertions are the independent oracle. Ignore skipped.txt as a selection rule. Also execute selected tests in a native engine to identify host/fixture limitations rather than silently removing cases.
quality_gate: Run the actual inspiring commit and its actual first parent with independently installed frozen dependencies. Require improvement before production changes. Then run the refreshed current baseline. No synthetic pre-feature stub is allowed.
safety: Do not add native eval, Function, Proxy, host-object access, arbitrary getters or broaden tool-reference access to gain passes. Any implementation must preserve existing confinement, resource limits and mutation invariants. Scope and maintenance cost can justify deferring the entire candidate.
selection_status: Feasibility benchmark only; no implementation selected, no production edits, no claimed improvement. Freeze a separate representative held-out usage set before selecting an implementation. Existing official tests are development evidence, not a claimed blind holdout.
